plain_english_policy: This option addresses tax code symmetry for married couples versus separate filers. In the U.S., 'marital penalty' or 'bonus' issues are often debated; eliminating penalties (making taxes equal) is generally viewed as progressive by reducing household income concentration, while maintaining status quo can be seen as conservative fiscal conservatism depending on context.
